name: Door machine
blurb: A state machine written in a notation of its own, painted by the grammar the tool ships, with no host highlighter needed.

inputs.label: Machine
inputs.description: One state or transition per line. # starts a comment.
inputs.default:
# A door that locks
initial closed
state open
state locked "needs a key"
on push: closed -> open
on pull: open -> closed
on lock: closed -> locked
on unlock: locked -> closed

inputs.label: Button labels
inputs.description: JSON, which the host's highlighter knows, so it paints this one rather than the grammar.
